message.text: Go embed.FS serves the compiled dist. Echo static middleware and SPA fallback handle requests. The wiring is in server/router/frontend/frontend.go and server/server.go.
The mechanism is `go:embed` of the `dist` directory combined with Echo Static middleware and an SPA fallback. It is wired in `frontend.go`, while `server.go` handles the actual server setup.

q27.
go:embed of `dist` + Echo static/SPA middleware; server/router/frontend/frontend.go

`//go:embed dist/*` is served with `middleware.StaticWithConfig` and `spaFallbackMiddleware`. `server/server.go` starts it via `frontend.NewFrontendService(...).Serve(...)`.
